committed_on: 2026-10-27, before any C1 dataset was generated
definition: Attacked sessions use a careful attacker: per-satellite C/N0 equals the authentic C/N0 plus Gaussian error (sd 1.0 dB), and the satellite geometry is not changed. Position, velocity, clock-coupling, lock-reset and Galileo behaviour are sampled exactly as in the default attacker. Clean sessions are unchanged.

datasets.sim_default1: --n-clean 300 --n-per-attack 150 --seed 6161 (default attackers, fresh; the side-by-side baseline for this change)

detectors_unchanged: LightGBM, configs/sim_v3.json (all features) and configs/sim_v3_nostrength.json (strength features excluded), fitted and calibrated on sim_fa2 train and calibration splits exactly as for the gate test; nothing retuned
measures: detection (95% CI) overall and per attack type, on both datasets, for both detectors, side by side. False alarms are a property of clean sessions and are not changed by C1; the clean-session figure from the gate test applies.
hypothesis_not_a_result: Detection of the full detector falls on matched-power attacks; the no-strength detector changes little between the two datasets; the gap shows how much of the result rests on the strength cue.
after_this: If the detector is retrained with matched attacks in training, that is a separate, logged change tested on a new set; its results do not replace these.
